# Notice

This is an independent modern Fortran translation of the computational code
in RPEGLMEN. It is not the upstream R package and does not provide an R or
Rcpp interface.

The original authors retain copyright in the upstream work. The translation
retains the upstream GPL (>= 2) licensing terms and includes the original
source snapshot. Algorithmic corrections and interface changes are described
in `PORTING_NOTES.md` rather than silently represented as exact source parity.
